name: SmolLM
description:
Here is how to read the SmolLM config.json. The architecture class is LlamaForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 2,048: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 49,152 × 2,048: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 32, so each head sees 64 dimensions (2,048 / 32). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 2048 / 32 = 64. 64 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly), and a power of two (Triton / FlashAttention-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_key_value_heads is 32, so this is multi-head attention (MHA): every query head keeps its own key/value.

num_hidden_layers is 24: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

intermediate_size is 8,192. In a SwiGLU MLP this is the high-dimensional workspace: the 2,048-wide stream is projected up, activated with silu, then projected back. Labs usually round this width to a multiple of 128 or 256 so it tiles on the chip.

max_position_embeddings is 2,048 tokens — the context window in the config. There is no rope_scaling entry, so the rotary positions are used as-is. rope_theta is 10000.0: that is the wavelength of the rotary embedding. A larger theta keeps distant tokens from aliasing after a full rotation.

vocab_size is 49,152. 49,152 is divisible by 256, the usual vocab-tiling grain. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

tie_word_embeddings is true: the same matrix is reused for input embeddings and the LM head.

torch_dtype is float32.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM-1.7B/blob/main/config.json.
